name: Natsuake Hotaru
source: A girl from the coastal town of "Shikama" in Tohoku region, a third-year high school student. Cheerful and honest, she can easily get along with anyone, no matter who they are. When someone is in trouble, she always reaches out to them. She lost her parents when she was young, and at the moment, she helps her grandparents taking care of a shrine on an island.
